meta.title: Gwangsoo Choi
meta.description: Portfolio of Gwangsoo Choi - product engineer anchored in Rails, working across SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose. Available for mid-to-long-term contract work.

capabilities.title: What I can own
capabilities.item1_desc: Reading existing specs and code, adding features, fixing root causes of incidents, cleaning up async processing and operational paths.
capabilities.item2_desc: Wiring SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose to APIs, screen state, push notifications, and closing feature gaps between the two platforms.
capabilities.item3_desc: Input/output safety decisions, fail-closed design, credit reserve/commit/refund, and duplicate-execution prevention.
capabilities.item4_desc: Localization, admin tooling, monitoring, store releases and continuous improvement after launch.

background.military_summary: ROK Army 2nd Infantry Division, Sergeant, Honorable Discharge

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: Available for mid-to-long-term contract work. If you'd like to discuss a project, feel free to reach out.

statement.title: A Few Words
statement.p1: After SI/SE work, startups, and freelancing, I now run everything from planning through development and operations as a solo full-stack developer. My focus is building mobile apps that earn: I hand implementation to AI agents and own the overall system design and review myself. I also cover marketing and UI/UX design.
statement.p2: I care about shipping new ideas fast and reliably so the value actually reaches users, and about responding quickly to whatever friction they hit after a release. Fast delivery looping back through user feedback is what makes a product strong.
statement.p3: Reaching the goals of my own products comes first, so I'm not looking for full-time roles — only freelance contracts of 20–30 hours a week. If you'd like to build something fun together, get in touch.
